title: Lesson 32 - Choosing the Right Determinism Mechanism: Scenarios and Traps
description: Given a use case, manage deterministic behavior for the agent using mechanisms like filters, variables, and template expressions.

questions.question: A requirement says the transfer action must be impossible to call until every validation passes. Which mechanism delivers that guarantee?
options: A prompt line telling the model to wait
A variable holding a note about the state
A template expression showing the balance
An available when filter on the action that stays false until the gating variable is set
questions.explanation: Only an available when clause removes the action from the model's tool list until the gating variable is true, whereas prompt wording and an ungated variable note can both be bypassed.

questions.question: A customer's verified id must survive into a later subagent so the agent does not re-ask. What is the correct mechanism?
options: A variable set deterministically and read in later logic instructions
A template expression in the first subagent's prompt
A knowledge retriever on the customer record
questions.explanation: Context memory is not guaranteed across turns or subagents, so the fact belongs in a variable set by code and read later, which is what makes the cross-subagent reuse reliable.

questions.question: The reply must name the exact product the script already determined for the customer. Which mechanism do you use?
options: A template expression such as a reference to a promotion product variable in the prompt
Asking the model to look the product up in the prompt
An available when filter on the product action
A second gate variable to hold the product id
questions.explanation: A template expression renders the value the script already established, keeping the answer grounded, while asking the model to look it up routes a known fact back through the model and reopens the variability.
